name: relational_seed
description: Relational / multi-hop questions over data/samples (Phase 7): each needs two facts that are linked through an entity named in only one of them (the electrolyte someone owns, the supplier of a material used somewhere). Written from the sample documents, not from extraction output. Every evidence quote is checked against the ingested samples by tests/unit/test_evaluation.py. Recall@K = share of the two facts covered by the top-K chunks.
